ds4f-q2.description: 2-bit routed experts, about 81 GB on disk. Recommended model for 96 and 128 GB RAM machines.

ds4f-q2-q4.description: Mixed Flash quant: mostly q2 routed experts, with the last 6 layers using q4 routed experts. About 98 GB on disk. Good for higher quality inference for 128 GB MacBooks. Works on DGX Spark but loading may struggle compared to ds4f-q2.

ds4f-q4.description: 4-bit routed experts, about 153 GB on disk. Recommended model for machines with 256 GB RAM or more.

ds4f-mxfp4.description: Native DeepSeek V4 Flash MXFP4 routed experts, about 156 GB on disk. Supported by Metal and CUDA; Blackwell uses FP4 tensor cores for batched expert work, while CUDA decode keeps Q8 activations.

ds4f-dspark.description: Optional DSpark speculative decoding support GGUF for Flash 0731, about 6 GB. Enable it with --dspark and --mtp-model when running ds4 or ds4-server.

ds4f-vision-q2.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Experimental with 2-bit routed experts, about 81 GiB, plus its vision encoder. Recommended for 96 and 128 GB Macs.

ds4f-vision-q2-q4.description: Mixed Vision Experimental quant with routed experts in layers 37-42 at Q4_K and the others at 2 bits, about 91 GiB, plus its vision encoder.

ds4f-vision-mxfp4.description: Native MXFP4 Vision Experimental model, about 145 GiB, plus its vision encoder. Intended for CUDA or two 128 GB Macs using tensor parallelism.

ds4f-vision-encoder.description: Standalone Vision Experimental encoder, about 0.9 GiB. Use this when the matching language GGUF is already present.

ds4f-vision-dspark.description: Matching DSpark speculative decoding support for Vision Experimental, about 5.6 GiB. It is not compatible with the 0731 language checkpoint.

ds41f-q2.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 calibrated Q2, about 341 GiB on disk. Main weights occupy 152 GiB; Engram tables stay on disk. Metal only: use SSD streaming on one 128 GB Mac, tensor parallelism on two, or a larger resident Mac.

ds41f-q4.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash calibrated Q4, about 483 GiB on disk. Main weights occupy 294 GiB; Engram tables stay on disk. Metal only: use SSD streaming on smaller Macs or full residency on a 512 GB Mac. Downloads two parts and joins them automatically; allow another 37 GiB of free disk space.

ds41f-mxfp4.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 MXFP4 routed experts, about 467 GiB on disk. Downloads and verifies nine GGUF shards, then restores the original page-aligned GGUF. Retains the shards: allow about 935 GiB for shards plus output, with additional HF cache headroom. Downloads and merging can resume.

ds41f-vision.description: September V4.1 Flash vision encoder, about 0.9 GiB, matching ds41f-q4. For the current 1017 Q2, use ds41f-1017-vision instead. Does not update ./ds4flash.gguf.

ds41f-1017-vision.description: Matching 1017 BF16 vision encoder from kyuz0, about 0.9 GiB. Add --vision FILE to the language-model command. Does not update ./ds4flash.gguf.

pro-q2-imatrix.description: DeepSeek V4 PRO 0813 q2 imatrix quant, as a single GGUF file. About 430 GB on disk; intended for 512 GB RAM machines.

pro-q4-layers00-30.description: First half of the DeepSeek V4 PRO Q4 routed-expert quant, layers 0..30. Use on the coordinator in a two-Mac-Studio distributed run. About 426 GB.

pro-q4-layers31-output.description: Second half of the DeepSeek V4 PRO Q4 routed-expert quant, layers 31..output. Use on the worker in a two-Mac-Studio distributed run. About 412 GB.

pro-q4-split.description: Downloads both PRO Q4 split files into the download directory. About 838 GB total. This target does not update ./ds4flash.gguf.

glm-unsloth-q4.description: GLM 5.2 Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL quant from unsloth/GLM-5.2-GGUF. Downloads all 11 shards and links ./ds4flash.gguf to the first shard.

glm-antirez-q2.description: GLM 5.2 antirez routed Q2_K GGUF from antirez/GLM-5.2-GGUF. About 262 GB on disk.

glm-antirez-iq2xxs.description: GLM 5.2 antirez routed IQ2_XXS GGUF from antirez/GLM-5.2-GGUF. Includes Q2_K block 78 and is intended for reduced-memory testing.

glm-antirez-q4.description: GLM 5.2 antirez routed Q4_K GGUF from antirez/GLM-5.2-GGUF. About 434 GB on disk.

glm53-full-q2.description: Full GLM 5.3 routed IQ2_XXS/Q2_K GGUF, about 197 GiB on disk. Intended for 256 GB machines or SSD streaming on smaller systems.

glm53-q2.description: GLM 5.3 Flash imatrix Q2 GGUF, about 90 GiB on disk. Intended for resident inference on 128 GB Macs.

glm53-q4.description: GLM 5.3 Flash Q4_K GGUF, about 178 GiB on disk. Intended for two-Mac tensor parallelism or single-Mac SSD streaming.

glm53-fp8.description: Text-only GLM 5.3 Flash native FP8 GGUF, about 305 GiB on disk. It preserves the released weights without requantization. DwarfStar inference support for this paired FP8-code/scale format is pending.

glm53-vision.description: GLM 5.3 Flash vision encoder, about 1.1 GB on disk. Load it separately with --vision; this target does not update ./ds4flash.gguf.

qwen38-q2.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q2: one 137.10 GiB GGUF. Main/MTP weights occupy 41.73 GiB; original BF16 n-grams stay on disk. Imatrix IQ2_XXS gate/up and Q2_K down experts (640 logical inputs, padded to 768 on disk), with higher-precision dense/control tensors. Smaller option for 64 GB Macs: start with --ctx 8192 and --prefill-chunk 1024. Context buffers need additional RAM. Keep the file on a local SSD. Add --mtp for speculation.

qwen38-q4k.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q4: one 165.11 GiB GGUF. Main/MTP weights occupy 69.74 GiB; original BF16 n-grams stay on disk. Imatrix Q4_K gate/up and MXFP4 down routed experts. Fits 128 GB Macs with room for context buffers. Add --mtp for speculation.

qwen38-vision.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next vision encoder, about 0.6 GB on disk. Load it with --vision; this target does not update ./ds4flash.gguf.

flint-int4.description: Recursive Flint affine INT4 with INT8 embeddings, about 22.6 GB. Downloads all five safetensors shards, tokenizer/config files and manifest into gguf/flint-int4. Native Metal serving on M5 Max; use ds4-local --server flint --model gguf/flint-int4. Leaves ds4flash.gguf unchanged.
